text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!
I'm so boooored!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What gives?!
Everyone keeps saying they're busy, busy, busy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Boring, boring, boooring!!
And here I thought I finally got a day off!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Windy-san! Shouting at the top of your lungs like that, whatever is the matter? Is it an emergency!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
O-Ooh, Fenomeno!!
Fate has brought us together at last—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I'm de-finitely not letting you get away!
Prepare yourself--!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: So what in the world is going on here—?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I see. Even though it's a rare day off, all your usual playmates have other plans, is that it—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Rest assured!
This officer is off-duty today.
I shall gladly keep you company to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooh, really~?! Hehehe, what should we play then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh~, Pheno-chan!
And Windy-chan too~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence~
Wait, are you two out on a stroll, too?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "We're, well... Hishi Miracle invited us out to search for little signs of autumn. ...Hehe."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Finding a little touch of autumn, I see...
Indeed, it has started feeling like autumn lately.
A leisurely stroll might be quite nice.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh!? Just walking around is so boring!
Let's do something way more fun—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An "encounter" with "ACU."
...It's "Gliese," isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, it's Rob Roy-chan and Universe-chan!
Hey hey, what were you two up to?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, we came to eat sweets.
I thought I'd enjoy the flavors of autumn with Uni-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “However, every restaurant is fully booked…… all because I neglected to make a reservation……”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Sheesh, you guys are hopeless! That's not how you're supposed to play!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rejoice! Windy-chan herself is gonna teach you how to enjoy autumn! Follow me, minions~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, you guys!
Dig up every last sweet potato in the academy~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Y-You caaaan't do that!
What in the world are you trying to do, sir?!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I mean, c'mon! Autumn means digging up sweet potatoes!
And roasting them up, too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, roasted sweet potatoes~. They're so good,
all piping hot and sweet...♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sure that would have its own charm.
...Still, doing it without permission is a bit...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll go ask
if there are any sweet potatoes we can dig up.
If not, we can always buy some at the store, right?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Then, Neo Universe will prepare...
"CFP" and "STNE".
To create—"Stone-Roasted Sweet Potatoes."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Keep it up, keep it up!
Everyone, work your hardest for Windy-chan~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Windy-san!
You have to say thank you properly, yes, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: However, I understand how you feel. It might not be much, but I shall assist you as well!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Leave the fire permit application and securing the venue to me.
Now everyone, let's get to work!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's cooked~! This one's for Mirako!
That one over there is for Rob Roy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Eat up without holding back, you lot!
Windy-chan grilled it all herself, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mirako & Neo Uni
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh~, so yummy~♪
—This is... 'delicious', isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Such an aromatic fragrance...!
Fufu, it's like I'm truly savoring the essence of autumn.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, really.
We made such wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It feels quite strange, yes.
...To think I'd be sharing roasted sweet potatoes
with people I only met by chance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If not for you, this moment surely wouldn't have been possible.
...Thank you, Windy-san.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh~, that's right! Have you finally realized Windy-chan's greatness~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing my errands outside and returning to the academy,
I heard lively voices coming from the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Trainer!
Hehe, you came at just the right timeâ

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You should eat some roasted sweet potatoes!
They're Windy-chan's special recipe, after all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Windy-chan's in a super great mood right now♪ So eat up and be grateful!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Perfect timing, I'm roasting the next sweet potato, so give me a hand!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's some for you too, Trainer,
so bake your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm, Trainer?
...Hmph, you're an unlucky one, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan and the others already ate all the roasted sweet potatoes!
...Though, that would be a different story if we dig up new ones!"
choice_data_list: Then I'll dig for potatoes too
Then, I'll dig up some sweet potatoes too.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kufufu, you really want to eat Windy-chan's roasted sweet potatoes that badly!?
Well fine then, bring some over and I'll roast 'em for ya!
